title: Adobe security advisory (AV26-888)
description: As of September 7, 2026, Adobe is affected by a vulnerability in the following products:
products:
Adobe Commerce
	All except Hotfix for CVE-2026-7565
Prior to or equal to 2.4.9-2026-aug, 2.4.8-2026-aug, 2.4.7-2026-aug, 2.4.6-2026-aug, 2.4.5-2026-aug, 2.4.4-2026-aug

Adobe Commerce B2B
	All except Hotfix for CVE-2026-7565
Prior to or equal to 1.5.3-2026-aug, 1.5.2-2026-aug, 1.4.2-2026-aug, 1.3.4-2026-aug, 1.3.3-2026-aug

Magento Open Source
	All except Hotfix for CVE-2026-7565
Prior to or equal to 2.4.9-2026-aug, 2.4.8-2026-aug, 2.4.7-2026-aug, 2.4.6-2026-aug
solution: Review the references and apply the necessary updates.
